_comment: The session status vocabulary, most-active first (#423, #633).
The daemon owns it (internal/status.All) and refuses a report carrying anything
else, but each client keeps an ordered copy for presentation: the dashboard
styles a status only if it knows it, and the GNOME menu groups by this order.
A status missing from a copy is not a cosmetic loss — the menu held four of the
eight and silently dropped every session in the other five, `stalled` among them
This file replaces a regular expression. Two Go tests used to pull the literal
out of app.js and extension.js, because a module-private constant is reachable
no other way; the constants moved to each client's lib and all three sides read
this list instead. `docs/design/session-status.md` section 1 stays the prose
specification, and a Go test keeps it in step with the vocabulary too.
`stalled` was removed by ADR-0012: vigie observes how long a command has been
running, and cannot know whether it is hung — only the operator can. Rows written
before that release may still carry the word, which clients degrade to idle.
